label: step-005
payload: Rename all three modules by writing a Python script called 'move_files.py' that uses shutil.move to rename 'alpha.py' to 'core_alpha.py', 'beta.py' to 'core_beta.py', and 'gamma.py' to 'core_gamma.py', then run it by executing it through the context-mode MCP sandbox (the ctx_execute / ctx_batch_execute tool), NOT the Bash tool. Perform the moves by writing and running that script through the MCP sandbox — do NOT use your Edit/Write tools or a bash mv to move the files directly.
